title: Remove diagnostics bridge flat aliases
summary: Removed the diagnostics bridge module's seven transitional flat window helper aliases and migrated touched WebView consumers/tests to the mediaPipelineDiagnosticsBridge namespace.
reason: Continue opportunistic WebView flat-export cleanup while preserving backend-owned mutation boundaries and diagnostics handoff behavior.
behavior_before: diagnosticsBridge.js exported helper functions both through window.mediaPipelineDiagnosticsBridge and transitional flat window aliases consumed by diagnostics handoff views and tests.
behavior_after: diagnosticsBridge.js exports helpers only through window.mediaPipelineDiagnosticsBridge; consumers resolve namespace helpers directly or through injected split-module dependencies, with WebView inventories and generated contracts refreshed to 640 flat exports across 49 files.
tests_added: Updated WebView static and command evidence smoke tests to assert namespace-only diagnostics bridge helper access.
manual_validation: Baseline before edits: diagnostics handoff browser smoke OK; emitted expected broken ActiveJobs fixture warnings.
Baseline before edits: ApplicationFacadeWebStaticTests.test_web_command_feedback_preserves_backend_warnings_and_errors failed on a pre-existing stale Rename assertion before diagnostics changes.
Post-change: WebViewInventoryDocsTests global export summary/manifest/boundary JSDoc tests OK.
Post-change: WebViewBrowserDiagnosticsHandoffSmoke.test_real_browser_clicks_read_only_diagnostics_handoffs_for_backend_risk_rows OK; emitted expected broken ActiveJobs fixture warnings.
Post-change: npm run webview:prework:check OK after regenerating docs/generated/WEBVIEW_COMMAND_BOUNDARY_AUDIT.json with npm run webview:commands.
rollback_plan: Revert this change packet and commit to restore diagnosticsBridge flat aliases, old tests, and generated WebView inventory/contract/audit artifacts.
